outcome: congenital depression of skull of a neonate at birth
cohort: A single neonate presenting with non-traumatic, congenital depression of the skull at birth.
finding: A case of non-traumatic congenital depression of the skull was reported in a neonate at birth, with no associated neurological deficit or intracranial abnormality on imaging, aligning with the general understanding that such conditions are mostly self-resolving.
